text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gains the Mi-Go subtype. Your Mi-Go characters gain T. After Mi-Go Skull leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Master of the Myths
text: Willpower. Toughness +1. Action: Pay 1 to put Master of the Myths into play from your hand. If Master of the Myths is still in play at the end of the phase, return it to your hand.

name: Vacant Servant
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains AA. Disrupt: If you win an A struggle at a story to which attached character is committed, sacrifice Vacant Servant to refresh 1 domain instead of readying a character.

name: The Red Threshold
text: Response: After you succeed at a story without losing any struggles, return a character you control to your hand. Then resolve the effects of any story in any player's won pile.

name: Sons of Hermes
text: Action: Pay 1 and exhaust a Criminal character you control to ready a Criminal character.

name: Fortifying Ouzo
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains Willpower and C. Action: Pay 1 to move Fortifying Ouzo to a different character.

name: Pawn Broker
text: Action: Pay 1 and discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

name: Breaking the Ward
text: Attach to an opponent's support card. Response: After attached card's ability is triggered, discard one card from the top of your deck to copy the attached card's effect without paying any costs. You choose all targets of the copied effect.

name: Ritual of Bellephar
text: Action: Choose a domain. The owner of that domain discards 1 card from the top of his deck for each resource attached to that domain.

name: Dr. Henshaw, Too Close to the Truth
text: Disrupt: When Dr. Henshaw would go insane, ready all other [Agency] characters committed to the same story.

name: Unforeseen Setback
text: Attach to a character. Response: After an opponent succeeds at a story, wound attached character.

name: Family of Fishers
text: Family of Fishers gains T if every character you control committed to the same story has the Deep One subtype.

name: Out of Season Monsoon
text: Response: Destroy a Location support card that just triggered an effect.

name: Painter of Delusion
text: Disrupt: Drive a Lunatic character insane to cancel a triggered character ability.

name: Seeker of the Songlines
text: Action: Exhaust Seeker of the Songlines to commit it to a story where there is at least 1 other committed character. You may only trigger this ability during the story phase.

name: The Musk Crow's Wind
text: Action: Choose 1 non-Ancient One character controlled by each player with cost X. Each chosen character is returned to its owner's hand.

name: Doctor Marama Riwhi, Warrior of the Mind
text: Willpower. Disrupt: When a character committed to the same story as Doctor Marama Riwhi would go insane, you may instead make any other eligible character you control go insane.

name: Deciphered History
text: Response: After an opponent places a success token on a story where you have 1 or more committed characters, discard that success token.

name: Kau'uli Warriors
text: Response: After an opponent destroys a character due to a C struggle at a story where Kau'uli Warriors is committed, search your deck for a card named Kau'uli Warriors. Then shuffle your deck and put Kau'uli Warriors on top of your deck.

name: Wooden Homunculus
text: Disrupt: When Wooden Homunculus would be destroyed, instead place it face down as a new domain and attach the top card of your deck to it as a resource.

name: Mask of Rakinui, Symbol of Power
text: Attach to a character you control. While attached character is committed to a story during your turn, you decide the order struggles resolve at that story. After Mask of Rakinui leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Taste of Lifeblood
text: Response: After a character is destroyed, refresh a domain.

name: Magnus Stiles, Blood Mage
text: Action: When you control more Sorcerer characters than any opponent, sacrifice a Sorcerer character to put a success token on a story. Limit once per round.

name: Necessary Evil
text: Action: Sacrifice a non-Ancient One character committed to a story. All characters you control committed to that same story gain the icons of the sacrificed character until the end of the phase.

name: The Sanguine Watcher, He Sees What Is Not There
text: Action: Pay X to look at the top X cards of an opponent's deck. Return those cards to the top of that deck in any order.

name: Outback Poacher
text: Response: After a Monster or Creature character is destroyed, draw 1 card.

name: Naval Tactics
text: Action: All character cards with skill X or lower do not count their printed icons until the end of the phase.

name: The Betrayer, Playing All Sides
text: If The Betrayer is able to commit to a story, he must commit to a story. Response: After The Betrayer is committed to a story, ready him to have each player reveal the top card of his deck. Then you choose whether each player discards that card or returns it to the top of his deck.

name: Song of Charybdis
text: Action: Choose a player. That player reveals the top X cards of his deck. Choose any number of cards revealed and place them on the bottom of that player's deck. Return the rest of the cards to the top deck in any order.

name: Customs Agent
text: Loyal. Action: Exhaust Customs Agent to raise the cost of the next card played this phase by 1.

name: Flush them Out
text: Play during your opponent's turn. Response: After your opponent has committed characters, choose a story. Uncommit each character at all other stories. Then commit them to the chosen story.

name: Uroborus, Fang of Yig
text: Response: After a Serpent character leaves play, put Uroborus into play from your hand. Action: If you have 3 or more Serpent characters in your discard pile, put Uroborus into play insane from your discard pile.

name: Sibilant Cry
text: Response: After a Serpent character leaves play, put any number of Serpent characters into play from your discard pile.

name: Elise Warren, Lady in Waiting
text: Invulnerability. X is the number of insane characters in play. Elise Warren cannot be the target of triggered effects while you control 2 or more insane characters.

name: Whisper in the Wind
text: Loyal. Action: Restore all insane characters you control. At the end of the turn, all Lunatic characters go insane.

name: Sonje Olson, Truth Seeker
text: Willpower. If you control 1 or more Tome cards, Sonje Olson gains AI. Response: After you have won an I struggle by 2 or more icons, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [Miskatonic] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Dr. Laban Shrewsbury, Extra-dimensional Anthropologist
text: Heroic. Willpower. Disrupt: When you draw Dr. Laban Shrewsbury, if you control at least 1 [Miskatonic] card, reveal him to your opponent and shuffle him into your deck. Then, choose and shuffle 1 Villainous character into its owner's deck or draw 1 card. (Limit 1 per turn.)

name: Celaeno Fragments, Book of Books
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains Fast and +1 skill for each Tome card in play. Response: After a player triggers the effect of a Tome support card, choose 1 Tome support card or 1 [Miskatonic] character in your discard pile and return it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Lucas Corn, Scarecrow of a Man
text: Response: After Lucas Corn enters play, discard a character from hand to shuffle Lucas Corn back into his owner's deck. Any opponent may trigger this effect.

name: Feed Her Young
text: Action: Attach Feed Her Young to a drained domain as a resource. Then, draw 1 card.

name: Chauncey Swann, Eldritch Acquisitionist
text: If you control 1 or more Tome cards, Chauncey Swann gains AI. Response: After your opponent returns a character he owns to his hand from play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [SilverTwilight] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then, place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Nathan Wick, Master of Initiation
text: Action: Discard a card from your hand to put a Lodge character into play from your hand. If that character is still in play at the end of the phase, discard it.

name: T'tka Halot, Umbral Codex
text: Attach to a Lodge character you control. If you have fewer cards in hand than each opponent, attached character gains II and does not exhaust to commit to stories. Action: Exhaust attached character to return the topmost Ritual or Spell card in your discard pile to your hand.

name: Jon Pechon, Man with a Plan
text: While Jon Pechon is exhausted, Criminal characters get +2 skill.

name: Go Underground
text: Disrupt: When a [Syndicate] character you control would be destroyed, return that character to your hand. Then, shuffle any cards you own attached to it, back into your deck.

name: Elder Thing Scavenger
text: Action: Exhaust Elder Thing Scavenger to choose a non-Location support card in any discard pile. Put the chosen card into play under your control. If the chosen card is still in play at the end of the phase, discard it.

name: Walk the Path
text: Response: After an opponent triggers an effect, copy that effect without paying any costs. You make any choices the copied effect requires.

name: Library of Alexandria, Repository of Philosophies
text: You may play Tome cards from your discard pile as if they were in your hand. Response: After a player triggers a Tome card's effect, choose 1 character and 1 story. Until the end of the phase that character gains or loses 1 A icon. Then the chosen story gains of loses 1 A struggle until the end of the phase.

name: Hall of Champions, Honoring Warriors Past and Present
text: Action: Exhaust Hall of Champions to search the top 10 cards of your deck for a card designed by a World Champion and put it into play. Then, shuffle your deck. If that World Champion card is still in play at the end of the phase put it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Teodor Corvin, Guardian of the Faith
text: Disrupt: Exhaust Teodor Corvin to cancel 1 wound to a character. Then that character gains Invulnerability until the end of the turn.

name: Cover Me!
text: Disrupt: If an [Agency] character you control would receive any number of wounds, instead choose an exhausted character to be wounded.

name: Shadowy Figure
text: Night. It is Night. After Shadowy Figure comes into play, destroy all Day cards. Action: Pay 1 to choose a character. Until the end of the phase, Shadowy Figure gains a C icon for each printed icon the chosen character has.

name: Dragged into the Deep
text: Action: Choose 1 non-unique card in play and place it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

name: Deranged Diva
text: Action: Drive Deranged Diva insane to choose a player. That player must choose 1 character he controls to go insane, if able.

name: Song of Suffering
text: Attach to an insane character. Attached character cannot be restored. Action: Pay 1 and unattach Song of Suffering to attach it to another insane character.

name: Research Assistant
text: Response: After a player triggers the effect of a Tome support card, ready Research Assistant to draw 1 card.

name: Infirmary
text: Loyal. Disrupt: When a [Miskatonic] character you control would be destroyed, return it to your hand instead of destroying it.

name: Black Dog
text: Fast. Willpower. Response: After an opponent commits exactly 1 character to a story, pay 1 to put Black Dog into play from your hand committed to that story. After that story resolves, if Black Dog is still in play, return it to your hand.

name: Maleficium
text: Disrupt: When a character is committed to a story, uncommit that character. Then, attach Maleficium to that character as an Attachment support card with the text: "Attached character cannot commit to stories unless its controller pays 1."

name: Sarah Van Shaw, Lodge Warden
text: Lodge characters gain CA if you control 1 or more Tome or Ritual cards. Response: After a character is put into play through a card effect, Sarah Van Shaw gets +2 skill until the end of the phase.

name: Knight of the Eclipse
text: Loyal. While there is 1 or more Tome cards in play, Knight of the Eclipse gains Invulnerability and Willpower.

name: Miranda Keeper, Antiquities Trader
text: If you control 1 or more Tome cards, Miranda Keeper gains CC. Response: After a character's skill is lowered, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [Syndicate] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Sergeant Donnelly, Corrupt Cop
text: Action: Pay 2 to choose a non-Ancient One character committed to the same story as Sergent Donnelly. That character's skill is lowered to 0 until the end of the phase.

name: O'Bannion's Ledger, Keeping Score
text: Attach to a character. Characters with 0 skill committed to the same story as attached character are discarded from play.

name: George Rogers, Obsessed Devotee
text: If you control 1 or more Tome cards, George Rogers gains CA. Response: After a player discards 2 or more cards from a deck in the same phase, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [Yog-Sothoth] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Houngan Seydou, Remover of Obstacles
text: Action: Pay X to choose a character without 1 or more Attachment support cards attached to it, committed to the same story as Houngan Seydou. Uncommit that character. X is equal to the skill of that character.

name: Eltdown Shards, Book of Hidden Things
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains AA. Response: After you win an A struggle at a story where the attached character is committed, choose an opponent. Look at that opponent's hand and choose and discard 1 card from that hand.

name: Library of Pergamum, Place of Ancient Wisdom
text: Disrupt: Exhaust Library of Pergamum to cancel an effect just triggered that would destroy a Tome card. Response: After a player triggers a Tome card's effect, choose 1 character and 1 story. Until the end of the phase that character gains or loses 1 C icon. Then, the chosen story gains or loses 1 C struggle until the end of the phase.

name: Marcus Jamburg, Finder of Lost Things
text: Toughness +1. Action: Return Marcus Jamburg to your hand to choose and put into play a support card from your discard pile.

name: Paid Informant
text: Action: Pay 2 and exhaust Paid Informant to choose an opponent. Until the end of the phase, that opponent must play with his hand revealed.

name: Black Maria
text: Response: After a character you control is wounded, exhaust Black Maria to choose a non-Ancient One character. That character cannot commit to stories while the Black Maria remains exhausted.

name: Dr. Wentworth Moore, Dark Supplicant
text: Villainous. Forced Response: After you succeed at a story where Dr. Wentworth Moore is committed, return a [Cthulhu] character from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Cthaat Aquadingen, Things of the Water
text: Response: After you play a Deep One character, choose a non-Location support card. Shuffle that card into its owner's deck.

name: The Carpathian, Tomb Raider
text: If you control 1 or more Tome cards, The Carpathian gains CA. Response: After a player sacrifices a character, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [Cthulhu] support card, reveal it and put in into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Alyssa Graham, Speaker to the Dead
text: Disrupt: When a player would draw a card, drive Alyssa Graham insane to (choose one): discard that card, or place the top card of your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: The Parlor, Where Truths are Revealed
text: Each card drawn by an opponent must be revealed before it is added to that player's hand.

name: Professor of Folklore
text: Disrupt: Pay 1 to cancel a wound to a [Miskatonic] character. If you overpaid for this effect, you may ready that character.

name: Dr. Mya Badry, Medical Examiner
text: Disrupt: When a character committed to a story is destroyed, put Dr. Mya Badry into play from your hand committed to that story. Then, if Dr. Mya Badry is still in play at the end of the phase, return her to your hand.

name: Karin Marley, Night Witch
text: If you control 1 or more Tome support cards, Karin Marley gains TC. Response: After an opponent drains his last domain, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [Shub-Niggurath] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Corrupted Midwife
text: Villainous. Action: Exhaust Corrupted Midwife to choose 1 character in your discard pile. Play that character as if it were in your hand as your next action.

name: Book of Iod, Hostiam Sanguinis Virtus
text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Exhaust Book of Iod to reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one of the cards into your hand and discard the other.

name: Lodge Defenses
text: Attach to a Location support card. Increase the cost of any effect that targets attached Location support card by 2. Response: After you sacrifice a [SilverTwilight] character, pay X to choose and return a character with cost X or lower from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Pass Grip of a Master
text: Action: Choose 1 character and 1 icon. Until the end of the phase, that character gains that icon. If Pass Grip of a Master was the last card in your hand, instead all [SilverTwilight] characters you control gain that icon until the end of the phase.

name: Thomas Fleming, Financial Wizard
text: Action: Pay 1 to choose a resource attached to a domain you control. Exchange that resource with the top card of your deck.

name: The Penthouse, Fortune's Reward
text: Response: After you succeed at a story, exhaust The Penthouse to choose and refresh a domain you control.

name: Shoshana Hatch, Warped and Warping
text: Action: Drive Shoshana Hatch insane to choose a struggle at a story she is committed to. That struggle does not resolve at this story, this phase.

name: The Gate of The Silver Key, Convergence of Space-Time
text: Attach to a story card. Forced Response: After you succeed at the attached story, put The Gate of The Silver Key on the bottom of your deck. Then, reveal the top 10 cards of a player's deck and put them back in any order.

name: Library of Nalanda, Site of Celestial Learning
text: Your characters with 1 or more attached Tome cards get +3 skill. Response: After a player triggers a Tome card's effect, choose 1 character and 1 story. Until the end of the phase that character gains or loses 1 T icon. Then the chosen story gains or loses 1 T struggle until the end of the phase.

name: A Fortunate Accident
text: Response: After a character you control is destroyed, put a character with a cost equal to or lower than the destroyed character cost into play from your hand.

name: Jenica Capra, Police Psychic
text: If you control 1 or more Tome cards, Jenica Capra gains AI. Action: If you have no support cards in play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an [Agency] support card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Limit once per turn.

name: Daemonolatreia, Witchhunter's Guide
text: Attach to a character you control. While attached character is committed to a story, opponents cannot play event cards.

name: Brother James Xavier, The Jesuit
text: Heroic. Willpower. Character abilities cannot be triggered while Brother James Xavier is committed to a story.

name: Descendent of Yig
text: Fast. Forced Response: After Descendent of Yig is destroyed, choose a player. That player must sacrifice a character.

name: The Warrens, Despair-ridden Tenement
text: Serpent characters gain TT. Action: Sacrifice a Serpent character to choose a story. Until the end of the phase that story gains:

name: Danni Devine, Mercurial and Mischievous
text: Villainous. If you control 1 or more Tome cards, Danni Devine gains TA. Action: If there are 2 or more insane characters in play, search the top 5 cards or your deck for a [Hastur] support card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Maureen de Garmeaux, Method Actress
text: Action: Pay 3 to choose a non-Ancient One character. Maureen de Garmeaux gains the skill, icons, and text box of that character until the end of the phase. If Maureen de Garmeaux is still in play at the end of the phase, she goes insane.

name: The King In Yellow Folio, Cursed Manuscript
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains Fast and TT. All struggles at the story where attached character is committed become T struggles.

name: Watchful Naturalist
text: Action: Pay 1 to choose an icon. Each Monster and Creature character in play loses 1 instance of that icon.

name: Combing the Archives
text: If you win this conspiracy, put into play under your control all Tome support cards in each player's discard pile.

name: Into The Woods
text: If you win this conspiracy, search the top 10 cards of your deck and put into play any number of characters whose total cost is 5 or less. Then shuffle the rest of the cards back into your deck.

name: Abhorrent Spore
text: Attach to a non-Ancient One character you control. Disrupt: When attached character would be destroyed, instead discard all wound tokens and attachments, including Abhorrent Spore, on attached character.

name: Lodge Neophyte
text: Disrupt: When a Lodge character would be destroyed, instead sacrifice Lodge Neophyte to return that character to its owner's hand.

name: O.E.S. Ring
text: Attach to a [SilverTwilight] character. Action: Pay 1 to choose a character. Attached character gains each keyword the chosen character has.

name: Fence
text: Disrupt: When an opponent's Attachment card would leave play, instead take control of that Attachment card and attach it to Fence.

name: Lookout
text: Response: After a character enters play, exhaust Lookout to exhaust that character. Until the end of the phase, treat that character as if its text box was blank.

name: Servant to the Elder Things
text: Action: Exhaust Servant to the Elder Things to choose an opponent. If you have more than 1 card in your discard pile, that opponent must choose a card in your discard pile. Return that card to your hand.

name: Feral Elder Thing
text: At the beginning of your turn, each player chooses and discards 2 cards from his hand, if able. Then, each player draws 1 card.

name: Library of Ebla, The First Library of Man
text: Action: Pay 1 to move 1 Tome card attached to a character you control to another character. Response: After a player triggers a Tome card's effect, choose 1 character and 1 story. Until the end of the phase that character gains or loses 1 I icon. Then the chosen story gains or loses 1 I struggle until the end of the phase.

name: Professor Zeus, Shrewd Archivist
text: While you control 1 or more Tome support cards, Relic Hunter characters you control cannot be targeted by opponents' triggered effects. Action: Pay 1 to chose a Tome support card in your discard pile. Return that card to your hand. Then, Professor Zeus gains A and +2 skill, until the end of the phase.

name: St. Amabilis, For the Criminally Insane
text: Response: After a character becomes insane, exhaust St. Amabilis to wound that character.

name: Dr. Cornelius Rose, Criminal Profiler
text: Willpower. Heroic. Forced Response: After a story resolves to which both Dr. Cornelius Rose and at least 1 Villainous character are committed, ready Dr. Cornelius Rose.

name: Padma Amrita, Cold-blooded Charmer
text: Response: After Padma Amrita is destroyed, put a [Cthulhu] character into play from your hand.

name: Urumi
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains TC and :

name: The Necronomicon, Owlswick Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Action: Sacrifice attached character and shuffle The Necronomicon into your deck to have each player sacrifice each character with a lower cost than attached character.

name: Kaleidoscope of Calyptra
text: Characters committed to the same story as Kaleidoscope of Calyptra that would go insane are instead wounded.

name: Named by the Unnameable
text: Action: Choose a Lunatic character you control committed to a story. That character gains TTCA and +3 skill while it is committed to that story. At the end of the phase, if that character is still in play it goes insane.

name: The Great Library of Celaeno, Knowledge from a Distant Star
text: Response: After a player triggers an effect on a Tome card, choose and ready any number of characters with 1 or more Tome cards attached. Those characters get +3 skill until the end of the phase.

name: Eryn Cochwyn, Disturbingly Insightful
text: Action: Drive Eryn Cochwyn insane to choose a Tome card and trigger its effect without paying any costs, as if you controlled the Tome. Then, the controller of that Tome card must sacrifice it.

name: The Necronomicon, Al Azif
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Response: After you place a success token on a story at which attached character is committed, sacrifice that character and shuffle The Necronomicon back into your deck. Then, place 1 success token on each story.

name: Ya-te-veo
text: Action: Pay 1 to choose a character with skill 2 or lower committed to the same story as Ya-te-veo. Wound that character.

name: The Three Bells, The Sound of the Dark
text: Action: Pay 1 and exhaust The Three Bells to have each player choose and sacrifice a character. Then, place a success token on The Three Bells. Action: When The Three Bells has 3 or more success tokens on it, exhaust and sacrifice The Three Bells to put into play under your control 1 character from any player's discard pile.

name: Ritual of Exclusion
text: Response: After a character is returned to a player's hand, place a success token on Ritual of Exclusion. Action: Exhaust and discard Ritual of Exclusion to choose and return up to X character cards from your discard pile to your hand. X is equal to the number of success tokens on Ritual of Exclusion.

name: Magical Theorist
text: Lower the cost to play Ritual and Spell cards by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Action: Exhaust Magical Theorist to add X success tokens to a Ritual support card. X is equal to the number of Tome support cards in play.

name: The Necronomicon, John Dee Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Action: If you have fewer cards in your hand than each opponent, return attached character to your hand and shuffle The Necronomicon into your deck to have each opponent choose a character he controls and return it to his hand.

name: Inside Man
text: Response: After Inside Man exhausts, reveal the top 3 cards of a player's deck. Then, put those cards back on top of that deck in any order.

name: On The Run
text: Action: Choose a story. Characters cannot commit to that story this phase. Any characters committed to that story are uncommitted.

name: Tindalos Alpha
text: Disrupt: When Tindalos Alpha would leave play, instead put it on the bottom of your deck. Then, return the top 2 cards of your discard pile to your hand.

name: The Necronomicon, Theodorus Philetas Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Response: After you succeed at a story, sacrifice attached character and shuffle The Necronomicon back into your deck to have each opponent discard 5 cards from the top of his deck.

name: Pulled from the Beyond
text: Action: Choose a non-event card in an opponent's discard pile with cost X or lower. Put that card into play under your control. If that card is still in play at the end of the phase, discard it.

name: Elena Belskaia, Always Prepared
text: Action: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, draw 1 card. Limit once per turn.

name: Shadow War
text: If you win this conspiracy, wound any number of Cultist, Monster, and Servitor characters in play.

name: The Necronomicon, Simon Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Response: After you win a C struggle at a story where attached character is committed, sacrifice attached character and shuffle The Necronomicon back into your deck to wound each character committed to each story with skill lower than attached character.

name: Ancient Plans
text: If you win this conspiracy, search your deck for an Ancient One character and put it into play.

name: Naaginn
text: Response: After a support card is destroyed, put Naaginn into play from your discard pile.

name: The Marked
text: Non-Ancient One characters lose all T icons. Disrupt: If you control 2 or more insane characters, drive The Marked insane to cancel a character ability just triggered. Then, that character goes insane.

name: In The Court of the Dragon
text: If you win this conspiracy, take control of each insane character in play.

name: The Necronomicon, Petrus de Dacia Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Disrupt: When attached character would become insane, shuffle The Necronomicon into your deck to make each character with lower skill than the attached character also go insane.

name: Surprising Find
text: Response: After an opponent draws 1 or more cards, draw the top 3 cards from your deck. Then, place 2 cards from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Faculty Advisor
text: Disrupt: If a Student character would be wounded or made insane, instead sacrifice Faculty Advisor. Then, draw 1 card.

name: Arthur Todd, Possessed and Typhlotic
text: Action: Sacrifice Arthur Todd to reduce the cost of the next [Shub-Niggurath] character you play this phase by 5 (to a minimum of 1).

name: The Necronomicon, Olaus Wormius Translation
text: Attach to a character you control. Shuffle all other copies of The Necronomicon back into their owners' decks. Action: Sacrifice attached character and shuffle The Necronomicon into your deck to put into play all characters from your discard pile with less skill than the attached character.

name: Lord of the Woods, Avatar of Shub-Niggurath
text: Invulnerability. Villainous. Action: Sacrifice a Tome card to destroy Lord of the Woods. Any player may trigger this effect.

name: Adept of the Second Order
text: Response: After a character is put into play through a card effect, choose and ready a Lodge character.

name: From the First Degree to the Last
text: If you win this conspiracy, choose any number of conspiracies or stories. Return each character committed to those stories or conspiracies to its owner's hand.

name: Street Tough

name: Seer of the Gate
text: Response: After Seer of the Gate enters play, name a card. Each opponent reveals his hand and discards all copies of the named card, if able.

name: Nowhere to Hide
text: Discard all success tokens from all stories.

name: The Shadow out of Time
text: Each player may exchange any number of cards in his hand with an equal number of cards from the top of his discard pile.

name: Opening Night
text: All discarded characters are put into play, insane.

name: Ancient Apocrypha
text: Each player gains a new domain, and attaches all character cards in his discard pile to that domain as resources.

name: The Call of Cthulhu
text: Each player searches his deck for a card and puts it into his hand. Shuffle the decks.

name: Through the Gates
text: Each player sacrifices all characters with printed skill 3 or higher.

name: Rotting Away
text: Each player sacrifices all characters with printed skill 2 or lower.

name: Frozen in Time
text: Each player must discard 2 cards from his deck for each resource attached to each of his domains, or destroy that resource.

name: Dreamwalkers
text: Each player must choose one of his won story cards (other that this one) and shuffle it back into the story deck.

name: The Other Path
text: Each player may place 1 success token on any story on which he has 2 or fewer success tokens.

name: The Secrets of Arkham
text: Resolve the effects of all other non-conspiracy story cards in play.

name: They Come at Night
text: Each player names a character or support card. All copies of the named card are sacrificed.

name: Obsessive Research
text: Each player draws until he has 8 cards in hand.

name: Change of Plans
text: Each player chooses a domain and attaches his hand to that domain as resources.

name: The Terror out of Dunwich
text: Each player chooses one resource attached to each of his domains. All other resources are destroyed.

name: The Innsmouth Threat
text: Discard all success tokens on all story cards.

name: The Thing at the Gate
text: Each player sacrifices all of his characters.

name: The Secret of the North Woods
text: Each player puts into play all characters in his discard pile.

name: The Dreams of Kingsport
text: After you win this story, choose Day or Night. Each player searches his deck for a card with that keyword, puts that card into play, then shuffles his deck.

name: The Well
text: Each player chooses one story card which he has won (except this one) and shuffles it into the story deck. Then destroy all Day and Night cards in play.

name: The Opened Door
text: Each player may take any number of cards from his hand and exchange them with an equal number of resources attached to a single domain he controls.

name: The 9th Plague
text: Each player sacrifices all of his characters committed to this story.

name: The Second Dragon
text: Each player may choose a non-unique character he controls and search his deck for any number of cards with the same title. Put those cards into play. Then each player shuffles his deck.

name: Within the Ice
text: Return all characters committed to this story to their owner's hands.

name: Come the Dreamtime
text: After you replace this story, rearrange any revealed stories, leaving all success tokens on the board in place.

name: Heart of the Labyrinth
text: Each player names a card type. The player to his left must then choose a card of that type he controls and return it to hand.

name: Congress of the Keys
text: Each player must shuffle his hand into his deck and then draw the same number of cards. Then the player who won this story draws 1 card.

name: Chaos Unleashed
text: Choose 1 domain you control. Take all resources attached to it and place them into your hand. Replace those resources with an equal number of cards off the top of your deck.

name: Village of Ash
text: Each player chooses one story card that he has won (except this one) and shuffles it into the story deck. Then, shuffle all Relic cards in play into their owners' decks.

name: A New Challenge
text: After you replace this story, take all success tokens for each player and redistribute them between the revealed stories. No more than 4 success tokens can be assigned to any story on either player's side.

name: The Heirloom
text: Each player may search his deck for a support card, reveal it, and put that card into his hand. Then each player shuffles his deck.

name: The Seventh Gate
text: Search the story deck and choose 1 story card. Resolve that story's effect and then place into your won pile. Then shuffle The Seventh Gate into the story deck.

name: Crack in the Ice
text: Choose a card in play and remove it from the game.

name: The Nameless City
text: Players need 10 success tokens in order to win this story. If you win this story, you win the game.

name: The Challenge from Beyond
text: Players cannot win this story card. Forced response: after a player places 1 or more success tokens on this story, he draws 2 cards.

name: The Horror of the Past
text: Each player shuffles his discard pile into his deck.

name: The Arkham Willows
text: Each player discards the top 10 cards of his deck.

name: The Forgotten Sepulchre
text: Each player searches his deck for one character card and one non-Day or non-Night support card and puts them into play. Then each player shuffles his deck.

name: The Crooked Manse
text: Each player gains a new Domain with the top 4 cards of his deck attached to it as resources.

name: Abysses of Night
text: Each player choose one resource attached to each of his domains. All resources not chosen are sacrificed.

name: Beyond the Doors of Sleep
text: Each player that controls no Day or Night cards discards all of his success tokens from all story cards.

name: Digging Deep
text: Each player searches his deck for up to 3 Attachment cards, reveals them to all opponents, and puts them into his hand. Then, each player shuffles his deck.

name: Dark Heart of Cairo
text: Each player chooses up to 2 Support cards controlled by the opponent to his left. All chosen Support cards are destroyed.

name: Parables of the Faceless One
text: Each player must choose and shuffle one of his won story cards into the Story deck (except Parable of the Faceless One)

name: Shadows of Nephren-Ka
text: Each player discards his hand.

name: The Squalid Hamlet
text: Each player chooses one of his domains, then attaches the top 5 cards of his discard pile to that domain as resources, if able.

name: The Unquiet Earth
text: Put into play from their owners' discard piles all characters with printed skill 3 or higher.

name: Throne of the Black Pharaoh
text: Each player draws 10 cards.

name: Voice of Thunder
text: Each player sacrifices all characters he controls.

name: The Dreams of Kingsport (CCG)
text: After you win this story, choose Day or Night. Each player searches his deck for a card with that keyword, puts that card into play, then shuffles his deck.

name: The Thing at the Gate (CCG)
text: Each player sacrifices all of his characters.

name: The Secret of the North Woods (CCG)
text: Each player puts into play all characters in his discard pile.

name: The Innsmouth Threat (CCG)
text: Discard all success tokens on all story cards.

name: The Terror out of Dunwich (CCG)
text: Each player chooses one resource attached to each of his domains. All other resources are destroyed.

name: The Well (CCG)
text: Each player chooses one story card which he has won (except this one) and shuffles it into the story deck. Then destroy all Day and Night cards in play.
